panel.summary: `runExport` refactor (generic export runner, per-label error logging, exporting/disabled gating) is untested
panel.evidence: `handleExportPdf` became a generic `runExport(label, fn)` used by two menu items; the guard `if (!store || exporting) return`, the toastId threading into success/error, and the new PPTX menu item have no test. Frontend does have component tests under `packages/frontend/tests/app/slides/**` (e.g. `toolbar/*.test.ts`, `format-panel/*.test.tsx`), so this kind of test is idiomatic here, but no `slides-export-button` test exists — a regression where both menu items call the PDF exporter would pass CI.
